title: Choose rendering strategy per route intentionally
guideline: Use server components/SSR for content-heavy or SEO-critical routes, client components for interactivity

title: Always use next/image for images
guideline: Get automatic responsive sizing, lazy loading, and format negotiation for free

title: Validate input in API routes/route handlers
guideline: Never trust client input in a route handler; validate and sanitize server-side

title: Set metadata per route for SEO/sharing
guideline: Use the metadata API (or next/head) for unique title/description per page

title: Use ISR/revalidation deliberately
guideline: Choose revalidate intervals or on-demand revalidation based on how fresh the data must be

title: Keep 'use client' boundaries small
guideline: Push 'use client' as deep in the tree as possible to minimize shipped client JS

title: Never expose secrets to the client bundle
guideline: Only prefix env vars with NEXT_PUBLIC_ when they're safe to ship to the browser
